def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A uniform, non-background line separates two panels. Keep their cellwise overlap.
    div_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if div_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:div_row], grid[div_row+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    div_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))), None)
    if div_col is None:
        raise ValueError('no separator')
    a, b = [row[:div_col] for row in grid], [row[div_col+1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(div_col, w-div_col-1)
    return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
PY
